$schema.description: The URI of the JSON Schema used to validate this configuration.

layers.description: Map each layer to the other layers it may import directly. Imports within the same layer are always allowed. Dependencies are not transitive.

files.description: Assign files to layers using glob patterns relative to this configuration file, with / as the path separator. The first matching entry wins. Unmatched files are not checked.

modules.description: Assign import specifiers to layers using glob patterns, such as node:** or electron. The first matching entry wins. Unmatched modules are not checked.

layerName.description: The name of a layer declared in layers.

include.description: Match any of these glob patterns.
